jwt.description: This header contains a JWT. Processing rules MAY depend on the typ header value of the respective JWT.

_claim_names.description: JSON object whose member names are the Claim Names for the Aggregated and Distributed Claims

_claim_sources.description: JSON object whose member names are referenced by the member values of the _claim_names member

_sd.description: Digests of Disclosures for object properties

_sd_alg.description: Hash algorithm used to generate Disclosure digests and digest over presentation

ace_profile.description: The ACE profile a token is supposed to be used with.

also_known_as.description: Stage name, religious name or any other type of alias/pseudonym with which a person is known in a specific context besides its legal name.

at_use_nbr.description: Number of API requests for which the access token can be used

ath.description: The base64url-encoded SHA-256 hash of the ASCII encoding of the associated access token's value

attest.description: Attestation level as defined in SHAKEN framework

authorization_details.description: The claim authorization_details contains a JSON array of JSON objects representing the rights of the access token. Each JSON object contains the data to specify the authorization requirements for a certain type of resource.

azp.description: Authorized party - the party to which the ID Token was issued

birth_family_name.description: Family name(s) someone has when they were born, or at least from the time they were a child. This term can be used by a person who changes the family name(s) later in life for any reason. Note that in some cultures, people can have multiple family names or no family name; all can be present, with the names being separated by space characters.

birth_given_name.description: Given name(s) someone has when they were born, or at least from the time they were a child. This term can be used by a person who changes the given name later in life for any reason. Note that in some cultures, people can have multiple given names; all can be present, with the names being separated by space characters.

birth_middle_name.description: Middle name(s) someone has when they were born, or at least from the time they were a child. This term can be used by a person who changes the middle name later in life for any reason. Note that in some cultures, people can have multiple middle names; all can be present, with the names being separated by space characters. Also note that in some cultures, middle names are not used.

bootcount.description: The number of times the entity or submodule has been booted

cdniets.description: CDNI Expiration Time Setting for Signed Token Renewal

cdnistt.description: CDNI Signed Token Transport Method for Signed Token Renewal

cnonce.description: "client-nonce". A nonce previously provided to the AS by the RS via the client. Used to verify token freshness when the RS cannot synchronize its clock with the AS.

consumerPlmnId.description: PLMN ID of the NF service consumer

consumerSnpnId.description: SNPN ID of the NF service consumer

crit.description: List of Claims in this JWT defined by extensions to this kind of JWT that MUST be understood and processed

dloas.description: Certifications received as Digital Letters of Approval

email_verified.description: True if the e-mail address has been verified; otherwise false

exi.description: "Expires in". Lifetime of the token in seconds from the time the RS first sees it. Used to implement a weaker from of token expiration for devices that cannot synchronize their internal clocks.

htm.description: The HTTP method of the request

htu.description: The HTTP URI of the request (without query and fragment parts)

intuse.description: The intended use of the EAT

keys.description: Array of JWK values in a JWK Set

manifests.description: Manifests describing the software installed on the entity

may_act.description: Authorized Actor - the party that is authorized to become the actor

measres.description: The results of comparing software measurements to reference values

measurements.description: Measurements of the software, memory configuration, and such on the entity

msisdn.description: End-user's mobile phone number formatted according to ITU-T recommendation

nationalities.description: String array representing the end-user's nationalities.

nonce.description: Value used to associate a Client session with an ID Token (MAY also be used for nonce values in other applications of JWTs)

oemboot.description: Indicates whether the software booted was OEM authorized

origid.description: Originating Identifier as defined in SHAKEN framework

phone_number_verified.description: True if the phone number has been verified; otherwise false

place_of_birth.description: A structured claim representing the end-user's place of birth.

preferred_username.description: Shorthand name by which the End-User wishes to be referred to

producerNfServiceSetId.description: NF Service Set ID of the NF Service Producer

producerNfSetId.description: NF Set ID of the NF service producer

producerNsiList.description: List of NSIs of the NF service producer which are authorized for the NF service consumer

producerPlmnId.description: PLMN ID of the NF service producer

producerSnpnId.description: SNPN ID of the NF service producer

producerSnssaiList.description: list of S-NSSAIs of the NF service producer which are authorized for the NF service consumer

rdap_allowed_purposes.description: This claim describes the set of RDAP query purposes that are available to an identity that is presented for access to a protected RDAP resource.

rdap_dnt_allowed.description: This claim contains a JSON boolean literal that describes a "do not track" request for server-side tracking, logging, or recording of an identity that is presented for access to a protected RDAP resource.

resOwnerId.description: Contains the identifier of the resource owner, e.g., GPSI as specified in clause 5.3.2 of .

sd_hash.description: Digest of the SD-JWT to which the KB-JWT is tied

sip_cseq_num.description: SIP CSeq numeric header field parameter value

sip_from_tag.description: SIP From tag header field parameter value

sip_via_branch.description: SIP Via branch header field parameter value

sourceNfInstanceId.description: NF Instance ID of the source NF

status.description: A JSON object containing a reference to a status mechanism from the JWT Status Mechanisms Registry.

status_list.description: A JSON object containing up-to-date status information on multiple tokens using the Token Status List mechanism.

sub_jwk.description: Public key used to check the signature of an ID Token

swname.description: The name of the software running in the entity

swversion.description: The version of software running in the entity

updated_at.description: Time the information was last updated

vc.description: Verifiable Credential as specified in the W3C Recommendation

verified_claims.description: A structured claim containing end-user claims and the details of how those end-user claims were assured.

vp.description: Verifiable Presentation as specified in the W3C Recommendation

jwk.description: JSON Web Key Representing Public Key

osc.description: OSCORE_Input_Material carrying the parameters for using OSCORE per-message security with implicit key confirmation
